Priya R: Heads up — candidate for SRE Sr moved to 3pm PT today. Need last-minute rooming + mentor pairing. Who can scribe/debrief? Candidate packet: https://intranet.redwood/candidates/1223 :eyes:
Elena K: I can scribe. Available 2:45–4:00 PT. Will take notes + timestamp action items. :+1:
Samir Patel: I can cover mentor pairing and do the tech deep-dive. FYI I prefer interviewer 1 handle system design, interviewer 2 do infra probes.
Maya G: I can handle AV/recording and ensure recording consent is captured. Do we need a separate consent form link?
Priya R: Yes please — we usually paste this pre-interview blurb: "By joining this interview you consent to a recording for internal debriefs." Can you post it in the calendar and in the invite chat?
People Ops Bot: Pre-populated consent link added to event description — https://intranet.redwood/consent. Candidate materials pinned.
Samir Patel: Quick rubric q: are we using the new rubric weights (tech 50 / system 30 / collaboration 20) or the old one?
Elena K: I have a local copy of the old sheet — tech 40 / design 30 / culture 30. Which one should scribes use?
Priya R: Use canonical rubric v2.1 — tech 50 / system design 30 / collaboration 20. Link: https://docs.redwood/internal/rubrics/sre-v2.1 Please annotate any outlier scores in the debrief.
Maya G: Posted consent + rubric link to the calendar invite. Also toggled recording to ON and set host to me.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "SRE Sr on-site loop — Candidate 1223" now at 2024-04-09T15:00:00-07:00 (3pm PT). Attendees: Priya R, Samir Patel, Elena K, Maya G.
Priya R: Thanks everyone. Final run-of-show (paste for scribe):
```
2:45pm — scribe huddle (quick expectations)
3:00pm — candidate intro (10m)
3:10pm — system design (35m)
3:45pm — infra deep-dive (30m)
4:15pm — quick Qs + wrap (10m)
4:25pm — debrief (scribe-led)
```
Priya R: If anyone can't make it, ping here ASAP. Otherwise I'll follow up post-interview with a short debrief template. :rocket:
